be taken to reclassify education under the state list from the concurrent list in the Constitution.

text: Revive English research centres.
source_text: English research centres will be revived

text: Hold coaching classes in collaboration with institutions such as British Council on MoU basis to equip government school children with spoken English skills.
source_text:
Coaching classes will be held in collaboration with institutions
such as British Council on MoU basis to equip government school children with spoken English skills.

text: Add subjects on environment and agriculture in the syllabus for school students to become aware of the world around them.
source_text:
Subjects on environment and agriculture will be added in the syllabus for school students to become aware
of the world around them.

text: Take steps to allocate at least 3 periods for physical education.
source_text: Steps will be taken to allocate at least 3 periods for physical education.

text: Take special steps to ensure linguistic minority students can learn their mother tongue in addition to Tamil and English languages at schools.
source_text:
Special steps will be taken to ensure linguistic minority students can learn their mother tongue in addition to
Tamil and English languages at schools.

text: Ensure transparency in the transfer process for state government school teachers.
source_text: Transparency will be ensured in the transfer process for state government school teachers.

text: Renovate and upgrade the Anna Centenary Library.
source_text: The Anna Centenary Library will be renovated and upgraded.

text: Ensure transparency in the procurement of books and procure better-quality books in the libraries under the purview of the Tamil Nadu Library Committee.
source_text:
Transparency will be ensured in the procurement of books and better-quality books will be procured in the
libraries under the purview of the Tamil Nadu Library Committee.

text: Take necessary steps to ensure youngsters who have cleared the TET exam and have not been allotted a job since 2013 get a job at the earliest.
source_text:
Necessary steps will be taken to ensure youngsters who have cleared the TET exam and have not been
allotted a job since 2013 get a job at the earliest.

text: Make legal recommendations to provide lifetime eligibility on TET qualification certificates.
source_text:
Legal recommendations will be made to provide lifetime
eligibility on TET qualification certificates.

text: Give interim jobs at various intervals to librarians working in rural areas.
source_text: Librarians working in rural areas will be given interim jobs at various intervals.

text: Give priority to first generation graduates in government jobs.
source_text: 179. Priority will be given to first generation graduates in government jobs.

text: Run coaching centres in every district to enable women who have graduated from colleges to gain employment opportunities.
source_text:
Coaching centres will be run in every district to enable women who have graduated from colleges to gain
employment opportunities.

text: Consider part time art, music and physical education teachers for permanent employment in the Department of School Education.
source_text:
Part time art, music and physical education teachers will be considered for permanent employment in the
Department of School Education.

text: Renovate and upgrade all district libraries.
source_text: All district libraries will be renovated and upgraded.

text: Upload all the details of the books in these libraries to an online catalogue for the public to view.
source_text:
All the details of the books in these libraries will be
uploaded to an online catalogue for the public to view.

text: Add new books and newspapers to all rural libraries established during the DMK period.
source_text:
New books and newspapers will be added to all rural
libraries established during the DMK period.

text: Establish libraries in the hometowns of notable Tamil poets- Karmegha Konar, Tamizhavel Uma Mageshwaranar, Na Mu Venkatasamy Nattar and Tamil Thaatha U Ve Swaminatha Iyer.
source_text:
Libraries will be established in the hometowns of notable Tamil poets- Karmegha Konar, Tamizhavel Uma
Mageshwaranar, Na Mu Venkatasamy Nattar and Tamil Thaatha U Ve Swaminatha Iyer.

text: Construct Thanmana Thalapathy Alagiri Memorial Hall in honour of Anjaanenjan Alagirisamy in Pattukottai.
source_text:
Thanmana Thalapathy Alagiri Memorial Hall will be constructed in honour of Anjaanenjan Alagirisamy in
Pattukottai.

text: Implement a massive scheme to provide 10 lakh jobs each year and 50 lakh jobs for youngsters at the end of 2025-26 from 2021.
source_text:
A massive scheme to provide 10 lakh jobs each year and 50 lakh jobs for youngsters at the end of 2025-26 will be
implemented from 2021.

text: Establish a new institution called STEP - State Board of Skill Training and Employment Promotion.
source_text:
A new institution called STEP - State Board of Skill Training and Employment Promotion
will be established.

text: Function employment centres as coaching centres.
source_text: Employment centres will function as coaching centres.

text: Establish Incubation Centres for startups, and create new employment opportunities in sectors including artificial intelligence.
source_text:
Incubation Centres will be established for startups,
and new employment opportunities will be created in sectors including artificial intelligence.

text: Pass Right to Skill Training Act to provide skill training and to ensure a job or self-employment opportunity for children who were abandoned by their parents, abandoned transgender people, persons with special needs who are unable to go to regular school.
source_text:
Right to Skill Training Act will be passed to provide skill training and to ensure a job or self-employment
opportunity for children who were abandoned by their parents, abandoned transgender people, persons with
special needs who are unable to go to regular school.

text: Appoint 3.50 youngsters from Tamil Nadu to the unfilled job vacancies across Tamil Nadu.
source_text: 3.50 youngsters from Tamil Nadu will be appointed to the unfilled job vacancies across Tamil Nadu.

text: Appoint 75,000 youngsters to supervise and act on behalf of the state government regarding the conservation and restoration of water bodies and forest areas across Tamil Nadu, reserving 30,000 seats for women candidates.
source_text:
75,000 youngsters will be appointed to supervise and act on behalf of the state government regarding the
conservation and restoration of water bodies and forest areas across Tamil Nadu. Of this, 30,000 seats will be
reserved for women candidates.

text: Appoint 75,000 road workers to TNRDC to supervise public assets including roads and bridges/flyovers, reserving 30,000 seats for women candidates.
source_text:
75,000 road workers will be appointed to TNRDC to supervise public assets including roads and
bridges/flyovers. Of this, 30,000 seats will be reserved for women candidates.

text: Appoint 25000 youth as temple employees to protect and conserve Hindu temples that are under the control and administration of Tamil Nadu HR&CE department.
source_text:
To protect and conserve Hindu temples that are under the control and administration of Tamil Nadu HR&CE
department, 25000 youth will be appointed as temple employees.
section: Conservation of Public Trusts and Charities- employment opportunities for 25000

text: Appoint 25000 women as community welfare workers who will act as liaison officers/ advocates that strengthen the capacity of govt officials to engage with citizens and ease communication between govt and the people, working in villages under the supervision of Block Development Officers (BDO).
source_text:
25000 women will be appointed as community welfare workers. They will act as liaison officers/ advocates
that strengthen the capacity of govt officials to engage with citizens and ease communication between govt and
the people. They will work in villages under the supervision of Block Development Officers (BDO).
section: Conservation of Public Trusts and Charities- employment opportunities for 25000

text: Set aside 15,000 crores to support the revival of such industries and enable employment opportunities to its employees by providing loans at low-interest.
source_text:
DMK will set
aside 15,000 crores to support the revival of such industries and enable employment opportunities to its
employees by providing loans at low-interest.
Increase the number of Industry Clusters

text: Implement policies that will enable diversified industrial growth based on natural resources and other resources, which will lead to increased economic opportunities, without limiting to the agricultural sector.
source_text:
Policies that will enable
diversified industrial growth based on natural resources and other resources will be implemented, which will lead
to increased economic opportunities, without limiting to the agricultural sector.
Creation of Special Companies to offset fiscal stress

text: Establish special and dedicated companies similar to TIDCO, SIDCO, TIIC to work alongside banks to offer financial support for the growth of micro and small business.
source_text:
Special and dedicated companies similar to TIDCO, SIDCO, TIIC will be established to work alongside
banks to offer financial support for the growth of micro and small business.
Closing gaps in technology

text: Strive to create tie-ups between IT firms and higher education institutions to bridge the gap and produce employable opportunities.
source_text:
To bridge this gap and produce
employable opportunities, DMK will strive to create tie-ups between IT firms and higher education institutions.

text: Introduce legislation to reserve 75 percent of private sector jobs for locals.
source_text: 196. DMK assures to introduce legislation to reserve 75 percent of private sector jobs for locals.

text: Propel to constitute an expert committee consisting of industrialists, banking experts, financial institutions and government departments to formulate necessary schemes and action plans to revive such micro and small enterprises.
source_text:
To revive such micro and small
enterprises, DMK will propel to constitute an expert committee consisting of industrialists, banking experts,
financial institutions and government departments to formulate necessary schemes and action plans.

text: Take steps to lay new power lines to industries and industrial estate to ensure uninterrupted supply of electricity.
source_text:
198. DMK will take steps to lay new power lines to industries and industrial estate to ensure uninterrupted supply
of electricity.

text: Re-introduce the single window system to encourage investments.
source_text: DMK will re-introduce the single window system to encourage investments.

text: Establish a new Ministry for Mines and Minerals to protect and regularise usage of mineral resources of the state including prevention of malpractices and abuse of resources and; to increase the revenue of the government.
source_text:
200. To protect and regularise usage of mineral resources of the state including prevention of malpractices and
abuse of resources and; to increase the revenue of the government, a new Ministry for Mines and Minerals will be
established.
section: New Ministry for Mines and Minerals

text: Take steps to strengthen the technological capacity of TAMIN.
source_text: Steps will be taken to strengthen the technological capacity of TAMIN.
section: New Ministry for Mines and Minerals

text: Introduce the policy and framework to regulate extraction of rare minerals and increase the revenue through such activities.
source_text:
The Ministry will introduce the
policy and framework to regulate extraction of rare minerals and increase the revenue through such activities.
section: New Ministry for Mines and Minerals

text: Set up a manufacturing plant to produce rubber based products to revive the distressed rubber workers in Kanyakumari who have lost their livelihoods.
source_text:
201. To revive the distressed rubber workers in Kanyakumari who have lost their livelihoods, DMK will set up a
manufacturing plant to produce rubber based products.
section: New Ministry for Mines and Minerals

text: Ensure that Tamil Nadu public sector undertakings set a goal of minimum 15 percent of its total annual purchases from the products of micro and small industries with 10 percent discount on the agreed pricing.
source_text:
202. As followed under the erstwhile DMK regime, Tamil Nadu public sector undertakings shall set a goal of
minimum 15 percent of its total annual purchases from the products of micro and small industries with 10 percent
discount on the agreed pricing.
section: New Ministry for Mines and Minerals

text: Plan and develop an industrial corridor between Madurai and Thoothukudi to promote industrial growth in Southern Tamil Nadu.
source_text:
203. To promote industrial growth in Southern Tamil Nadu, DMK will plan and develop an industrial corridor
between Madurai and Thoothukudi.
section: New Ministry for Mines and Minerals

text: Extend the Chennai-Thiruperumputhur industrial corridor to Hosur.
source_text: Similarly, extend the Chennai-Thiruperumputhur industrial corridor to Hosur.
section: New Ministry for Mines and Minerals

text: Offer business loans at low interest to first generation engineering graduates to encourage entrepreneurship.
source_text:
204. To encourage entrepreneurship, first generation engineering graduates will be offered business loans at low
interest.
section: New Ministry for Mines and Minerals

text: Set up new Industrial Training Institutes (ITIs) in industrial cities.
source_text: 205. New Industrial Training Institutes (ITIs) will be set up in industrial cities.
section: New Ministry for Mines and Minerals

text: Arrange for 20 lakh rupees as low interest loans for 25,000 persons each year through TIIC to support and encourage unemployed youth graduates that are interested in launching their own start-ups.
source_text:
206. To support and encourage unemployed (youth) graduates that are interested in launching their own start-
ups, each year TIIC will arrange for 20 lakh rupees as low interest loans for 25,000 persons.
section: New Ministry for Mines and Minerals

text: Take steps to establish Indian Institute of Foundries in Coimbatore.
source_text: 207. Steps will be taken to establish Indian Institute of Foundries in Coimbatore.
section: New Ministry for Mines and Minerals

text: Take steps for expansion and modernisation of Integrated Steel plants in Salem to increase its economic output and productivity.
source_text:
208. Steps will be taken for expansion and modernisation of Integrated Steel plants in Salem to increase its
economic output and productivity.
section: New Ministry for Mines and Minerals

text: Increase low intensity electrical power consumption of industries from 150 H.P to 200 H.P.
source_text: 209. Low intensity electrical power consumption of industries will be increased from 150 H.P to 200 H.P.
section: New Ministry for Mines and Minerals

text: Allow Powerloom units that consume electric power between 20 hp and 40 hp a subsidised tariff under Special rule III A 1 instead of regular under tariff III B.
source_text:
210. Powerloom units that consume electric power between 20 hp and 40 hp will be allowed a subsidised tariff
under Special rule III A 1 instead of regular under tariff III B.
section: New Ministry for Mines and Minerals

text: Set up Leather Parks in several districts including Dindigul, Vellore and Chennai.
source_text: 211. ‘Leather Parks’ will be set up in several districts including Dindigul, Vellore and Chennai.
section: New Ministry for Mines and Minerals

text: Revert the authority overseeing permission to use land as poultry farms from the Directorate of Town & Country Planning to its former authority, Panchayat Union that used to handle poultry licensing and development plans.
source_text:
212. The present authority overseeing permission to use land as poultry farms is the Directorate of Town &
Country Planning. DMK will revert this to its former authority, Panchayat Union that used to handle poultry
licensing and development plans.
section: New Ministry for Mines and Minerals

text: Develop action plan to promote and safeguard fireworks industries that provide livelihood to about 10 lakh families in the state.
source_text:
213. Action plan will be developed to promote and safeguard fireworks industries that provide livelihood to about
10 lakh families in the state.
section: New Ministry for Mines and Minerals

text: Set up a special industrial estate in Chidambaram to promote the business of gold covering and imitation jewellery both locally and globally.
source_text:
214. Chidambaram is renowned for its World-famous gold covering and imitation jewellery. To promote this
business, both locally and globally, a special industrial estate will be set up in Chidambaram.
section: New Ministry for Mines and Minerals

text: Urge the Central Govt to provide assistance to set up Common Effluent Treatment Plants (CETPS) in several districts including Tiruppur, Erode, karur, Dindigal, Vellore, Aruppukottai to manage and control the discharge of industrial effluents.
source_text:
215. Industries play a key role in air and water pollution.To manage and control the discharge of industrial
effluents, DMK shall urge the Central Govt to provide assistance to set up Common Effluent Treatment Plants
(CETPS) in several districts including Tiruppur, Erode, karur, Dindigal, Vellore, Aruppukottai.

text: Provide subsidised electricity to meet the power needs of the proposed Common Effluent Treatment Plants (CETPS).
source_text:
216. DMK will provide subsidised electricity to meet the power needs of the proposed Common Effluent
Treatment Plants (CETPS).

text: Take steps to create new Youth self-empowerment groups consisting of 15 persons to encourage employment opportunities among youth.
source_text:
217. To encourage employment opportunities among youth, steps will be taken to create new ‘Youth self-
empowerment groups’ consisting of 15 persons.

text: Provide 25 percent assistance while groups invest 10 percent, and the remaining amount shall be loaned through banks, and provide producers a 10percent incentive during the public procurement process.
source_text:
Govt will provide 25 percent
assistance, groups to invest 10 percent, and the remaining amount shall be loaned through banks. Producers will
be provided a 10percent incentive during the public procurement process.

text: Provide aid and assistance by the Govt under special schemes to safeguard and promote MSMEs including fireworks, locks, silk, mixers, grinders and exports.
source_text:
218. Tamil Nadu is home to many micro and small enterprises including fireworks, locks, silk, mixers, grinders.
Many families are dependent on this business for their livelihoods. To safeguard and promote MSMEs (including
exports), aid and assistance will be provided by the Govt under special schemes.

text: Set up warehouses across Namakkal to facilitate the egg refrigeration process that will allow the traders to store commercially sold eggs for a longer period to promote egg business.
source_text:
219. To promote egg business, warehouses will be set up across Namakkal to facilitate the egg refrigeration
process that will allow the traders to store commercially sold eggs for a longer period.

text: Increase electricity generation and distribution on wartime basis to provide uninterrupted supply of power to residents and commercial centers.
source_text:
220. Electricity generation and distribution will be increased on wartime basis to provide uninterrupted supply of
power to residents and commercial centers.

text: Replace the existing system of bimonthly payment of electricity bills with a monthly payment system to ease the financial burden on people.
source_text:
The existing system of bimonthly payment of electricity bills will be replaced with a monthly payment system
to ease the financial burden on people.

text: Enable a user household to save upto 6000 rupees (for <1000 units) annually through this scheme.
source_text:
This scheme will enable a user household to save upto 6000 rupees (for
<1000 units) annually.

text: Cancel the three-phase charge of 50 rupees levied with electricity charges.
source_text: The three-phase charge of 50 rupees levied with electricity charges will be cancelled.

text: Discontinue the existing electricity bill payment methods and make payments directly to the EB official that records electricity readings.
source_text:
This will be discontinued and payment shall be directly made to the EB official that records electricity
readings.

text: Encourage sugar factories across Tamil Nadu to produce electricity.
source_text: Sugar factories across Tamil Nadu will be encouraged to produce electricity.

text: Develop action plan to enable TANGEDCO to purchase electricity directly from such sugar factories.
source_text:
Action plan will be developed to
enable TANGEDCO to purchase electricity directly from such sugar factories.

text: Take steps to optimise the efficient usage of electricity by replacing the existing traditional power consumption at govt schools, govt colleges, temples and govt offices with solar panels to encourage consumption of renewable energy.
source_text:
To encourage consumption of renewable energy, steps will be taken to optimise the efficient usage of
electricity by replacing the existing traditional power consumption at govt schools, govt colleges, temples and govt
offices with solar panels.

text: Purchase power generated under the Agricultural biomass fuel producers scheme using the Public- Private Partnership (PPP) model via public procurement.
source_text:
Govt will purchase the power generated under this
scheme using the Public- Private Partnership (PPP) model via public procurement.

text: Incentivise unemployed graduates that show keen interest to invest and work in this field.
source_text:
Unemployed graduates that show keen interest
to invest and work in this field will be incentivised.

text: Take steps to lay special power transmission lines in Thoothukudi, Tirunelveli, Kanyakumari, Tiruppur, Dindigul, Pollachi, Udumalaipet and Theni to reduce electricity wastage, and promote efficient usage of electricity.
source_text:
To reduce electricity wastage, and promote efficient usage of electricity, steps will be taken to lay special
power transmission lines in Thoothukudi, Tirunelveli, Kanyakumari, Tiruppur, Dindigul, Pollachi, Udumalaipet and
Theni.

text: Lay underground cables (phased manner) across all cities in the state to prevent electricity theft.
source_text: To prevent electricity theft, underground cables will be laid (phased manner) across all cities in the state.

text: Take steps to revive the scheme of providing electricity to all ration cardholders in Nilgiris district.
source_text: Steps will be taken to revive the scheme of providing electricity to all ration cardholders in Nilgiris district.

text: Implement Udangudi Power Project and Cheyyur Thermal Power Projects on a wartime basis.
source_text: Udangudi Power Project and Cheyyur Thermal Power Projects will be implemented on a wartime basis.

text: Take necessary steps to increase power generation through renewable energy sources such as solar and windmills to produce additional 20,000 MW.
source_text:
DMK will take necessary steps to increase power generation
through renewable energy sources such as solar and windmills to produce additional 20,000 MW.

text: Remove old, expired private windmills and issue permission to install new windmills at the same places as per government guidelines.
source_text:
Old, expired private windmills will be removed and permission to install new windmills at the same places will
be issued as per government guidelines.

text: Ensure faster procurement of EN METER devices to increase solar power generation in the state.
source_text:
DMK will ensure
faster procurement of these devices to increase solar power generation in the state.

text: Provide eligible people who have applied for a ration card with a smart card within 15 days of application.
source_text:
Eligible people who have applied for a ration card will be provided with a smart card within 15 days of
application.

text: Provide 20 kgs of rice free of cost to ration card holders.
source_text: 20 kgs of rice will be provided free of cost to ration card holders.

text: Provide high quality rice through this scheme.
source_text:
High quality rice will be provided through
this scheme.

text: Bring ration shops that are under the control of several departments under a single department.
source_text: Ration shops that are under the control of several departments will be brought under a single department.

text: Upgrade all existing ration cards to smart cards.
source_text: All existing ration cards will be upgraded to smart cards.

text: Computerise the entire public distribution system.
source_text:
The entire public distribution system will be
computerised.

text: Display all details of available items in the ration shops on digital boards.
source_text: All details of available items in the ration shops will be displayed on digital boards.

text: Take steps to issue ration shop items including sugar, maida, dals, cooking oil in packets to ensure hygiene and fairness.
source_text:
To ensure hygiene and fairness, steps will be taken to issue ration shop items including sugar, maida, dals,
cooking oil in packets.

text: Issue 3 LED bulbs at a subsidised price to all card holders to promote energy-saving practices.
source_text: 3 LED bulbs will be issued at a subsidised price to all card holders to promote energy-saving practices.

text: Provide additional 1 kg of sugar at ration shops.
source_text: Additional 1 kg of sugar will be provided at ration shops.

text: Implement again the scheme to provide urad dal which was discontinued during the ADMK period.
source_text:
Scheme to provide urad dal which was discontinued
during the ADMK period will be implemented again.

text: Devise a Master Plan to improve tourism in the state, boost foreign exchange and employment in tourism and ensure welfare of tourists.
source_text:
A Master Plan will be devised to- improve tourism in the state, boost foreign exchange and employment in
tourism and ensure welfare of tourists.

text: Make infrastructural developments in tourist attractions such as Mahabalipuram, Courtallam, Ooty, Kodaikanal, etc.
source_text:
Infrastructural developments will be made in tourist attractions such as Mahabalipuram, Courtallam, Ooty,
Kodaikanal, etc.

text: Restore and renovate old forts, palaces and mahals constructed during Nayakas, Palaiyakkarars, Marathas period.
source_text:
Old forts, palaces and mahals constructed during Nayakas, Palaiyakkarars, Marathas period will be restored
and renovated.

text: Increase maternity leave for women working in state government jobs from 9 months to 12 months.
source_text: Maternity leave for women working in state government jobs will be increased from 9 months to 12 months.

text: Implement a special “Women and Child Welfare Scheme” under the direct supervision of the Chief Minister.
source_text:
A special “Women and Child Welfare Scheme” will be implemented under the direct supervision of the Chief
Minister.

text: Provide medical facilities including check-ups, medicines and vaccinations to pregnant women at their doorsteps by doctors and supporting staff in a mobile hospital through this scheme.
source_text:
Through this scheme, medical facilities including check-ups, medicines and vaccinations will be provided
to pregnant women at their doorsteps by doctors and supporting staff in a mobile hospital.

text: Create nursing (breastfeeding) stations with privacy in all public places.
source_text: Nursing (breastfeeding) stations with privacy will be created in all public places.

text: Raise reservation for women from 30% to 40% in all government jobs.
source_text: Reservation for women will be raised from 30% to 40% in all government jobs.

text: Urge the central government to pass the 33% reservation bill for women members in the Parliament.
source_text:
DMK will urge the central government to pass the 33% reservation bill for women members in the
Parliament.

text: Create awareness among women about different types of cancer that commonly affect women.
source_text: Awareness will be created among women about different types of cancer that commonly affect women.

text: Provide screening tests and diagnosis for the same in all government hospitals.
source_text: Screening tests and diagnosis will be done for the same in all government hospitals.

text: Take steps to form sexual harassment committees in all factories and industries as per legal guidelines.
source_text:
Steps will be taken to form sexual harassment committees in all factories and industries as per legal
guidelines.

text: Make safety of women from harassment and other untoward events at the workplace high priority.
source_text:
Safety of women from harassment and other untoward events at the workplace will be made high
priority.

text: Take steps to provide jobs for widowed/abandoned women above 35 years of age according to their qualification to ensure their safety and a good future for their children.
source_text:
Steps will be taken to provide jobs for widowed/abandoned women above 35 years of age according
to their qualification to ensure their safety and a good future for their children.

text: Create a welfare board for widowed women.
source_text: A welfare board for widowed women will be created.

text: Provide a total amount of Rs 24,000 given in 8 month installments to pregnant women under Dr Muthulakshmi Reddy Maternity Benefit scheme.
source_text:
A total amount of Rs 24,000 given in 8 month installments will be provided to pregnant women under Dr
Muthulakshmi Reddy Maternity Benefit scheme.

text: Construct working women’s hostels in all districts.
source_text: Working women’s hostels will be constructed in all districts.

text: Set up cyber police stations in all districts with technically qualified, trained employees to address the increasing prevalence of cybercrimes against women and children.
source_text:
Cyber police stations will be set up in all districts with technically qualified, trained employees to address the
increasing prevalence of cybercrimes against women and children.

Financial assistance for women’s marriage through Annai Teresa Orphan Girl Marriage Financial Assistance
scheme will be raised from Rs 25,000 to Rs 30,000. 8 grams of 22 carat gold will be provided.

Financial assistance for women’s marriage (for women who have studied till 10th standard) through
Moovalur Ramamirtham Ammaiyar Memorial Marriage Assistance Scheme will be raised from Rs 25,000 to Rs
30,000. 8 grams of 22 carat gold will be provided.

text: Raise financial assistance for ST and hilly tribal women’s marriage from Rs 25,000 to Rs 30,000 and provide 8 grams of 22 carat gold.
source_text:
Financial assistance for ST and hilly tribal women’s marriage (for women who have studied till 10th standard) will
be raised from Rs 25,000 to Rs 30,000. 8 grams of 22 carat gold will be provided.

text: Raise financial assistance for widowed women’s remarriage through Dr. Dharmambal Ammaiyar Ninaivu Widow Remarriage Scheme from Rs 25,000 to Rs 30,000 and provide 8 grams of 22 carat gold.
source_text:
Financial assistance for widowed women’s remarriage through Dr. Dharmambal Ammaiyar Ninaivu Widow
Remarriage Scheme will be raised from Rs 25,000 to Rs 30,000. 8 grams of 22 carat gold will be provided.

source_text:
A GO will be
released to re-implement this scheme.
section: Anjugam Ammaiyar Ninaivu Intercaste Marriage Assistance Scheme

source_text:
If one of the partners in an inter-caste marriage is from a Scheduled Tribe, a special assistance of Rs 60,000 and
8 grams of 22 carat gold will be provided.
section: Anjugam Ammaiyar Ninaivu Intercaste Marriage Assistance Scheme

text: Provide 25% subsidy along with loan facilities to women SHGs who invest 10% of total expenditure to manufacture products that will be procured on top-priority basis by government and public sector offices.
source_text:
